content:
Ivy Chen: Quick heads-up 30 deploying routing-service v0.9.0 in 8m (change window 06:00-06:30 UTC). Canary plan: 3% -> 20% -> 60%. Paid-cust route pinned to v0.8.9.
ops-oncall: Copy. Which version do we pin for rollback?
Ivy Chen: Rollback target v0.8.9. We also enabled the rollback kill-switch (manual) for first 20m. Auto-revert suppressed.
Sam Blake: Request adding a safety gate: abort promotion if (route-error-rate >= 0.4% for 4m) OR (p95 delta >= 180ms for 3m) OR any route-level 5xx spike. Also block if deploy-bot reports >2 route mismatches.
deploy-bot: Deploybot notice: rollout scheduled at 06:05 UTC for routing-service v0.9.0. Auto-revert suppressed per request. Health hooks: telemetry, route-integrity, smoke-eval.
release-desk: I'll draft release notes but will not publish until canary clears. Customer blurb to mention "no paid-customer impact" if we pause.
ops-oncall: Who has authority to flip the kill-switch?
Ivy Chen: Ops-oncall has authority first 20m; Engineering (Ivy) will approve any global revert.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic shifted to 3% -> v0.9.0. Baseline p95=95ms, error_rate=0.02%.
ops-oncall: Noticing p95 jitter to 140ms at 06:07 UTC. Watching.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics (06:09 UTC): p95=205ms sustained 3m, route-error-rate=0.12%. Trigger: p95 delta threshold breached.
Sam Blake: Pulling traces and route debug. Command to collect logs:
```
infra-logs fetch --service routing-service --filter "5xx OR timeout" --since 10m > /tmp/route-fails.log
```
ops-oncall: Evidence of malformed header handling on a subset of requests causing retries and higher latencies on worker-9. Given the sustained p95 breach and user-impacting retries, I'll flip the kill-switch and revert canary slice to v0.8.9 now.
ops-oncall: Executing:
```
/ops/release revert --service routing-service --to v0.8.9 --scope canary --confirm --note "kill-switch: malformed header retries"
```
deploy-bot: Revert acknowledged. Rolling canary back to v0.8.9. Traffic shifting off v0.9.0.
ops-oncall: Revert complete. Canary at 0% for v0.9.0. p95 returned to ~98ms.
release-desk: Draft posted to internal incident log: "canary paused due to header handling regression; paid routes unaffected; reattempt after patch+smoke eval." Will coordinate external comms if needed.
Ivy Chen: Follow-ups: add header-sanitizer to preflight smoke, add route-integrity counter to gating, and consider shorter canary steps for route-heavy releases. Sam, please open runtime ticket with attached /tmp/route-fails.log.
Sam Blake: Filing ticket now, attaching logs and traces.
ops-oncall: Closing bridge in 15m unless objections. Reattempt only after fix and passing smoke-eval.
Ivy Chen: Thanks team. Manual kill-switch used, canary reverted, release notes paused. Good run. :white_check_mark:
